claim: Under the current eCFR text, VEVRAA covers contracts and subcontracts of $200,000 or more.
quote: Contracts and subcontracts of $200,000 or more are covered by this part.

claim: OFCCP reports that the VEVRAA threshold increased from $150,000 to $200,000.
source_title: Updated Jurisdictional Thresholds for Section 503 and VEVRAA (OFCCP bulletin)
quote: the VEVRAA threshold increased from $150,000 to $200,000

claim: For Section 503, affirmative action program requirements apply to contractors with at least 50 employees and a single contract of $50,000 or more.
source_title: Updated Jurisdictional Thresholds for Section 503 and VEVRAA (OFCCP bulletin)
quote: For Section 503, the AAP requirements continue to apply to covered contractors and subcontractors that have at least 50 employees and a single contract of $50,000 or more.

claim: Covered contractors must immediately list all employment openings with the appropriate employment service delivery system (ESDS) where the opening occurs.
quote: The contractor agrees to immediately list all employment openings which exist at the time of the execution of this contract

claim: Listing with the state workforce agency job bank, or with the local ESDS where the opening occurs, satisfies the listing requirement.
quote: Listing employment openings with the state workforce agency job bank or with the local employment service delivery system where the opening occurs will satisfy

claim: Listings must provide the vacancy information in any manner and format the ESDS permits.
quote: contractors must provide information about the job vacancy in any manner and format permitted by the appropriate employment service delivery system

claim: Contractors must tell each state ESDS that they want priority referrals of protected veterans for openings at all locations in that state.
quote: it desires priority referrals from the state of protected veterans for job openings at all locations within the state

claim: Contractors must give the ESDS contact information for the official responsible for hiring at each location.
quote: the contact information for the contractor official responsible for hiring at each location

claim: Executive and senior management, positions filled from within the organization, and positions lasting three days or less are excluded from all employment openings.
quote: includes all positions except executive and senior management, those positions that will be filled from within the contractor's organization, and positions lasting three days or less.

claim: Listing requirements in paragraphs 2 and 3 do not apply to openings that occur and are filled outside the 50 states.
quote: The provisions of paragraphs 2 and 3 of this clause do not apply to the listing of employment openings which occur and are filled outside of the 50 states

claim: For a remote job, the contractor may list with an ESDS in any area where qualified candidates might be found.
quote: The contractor may, therefore, satisfy the job listing requirement for a remote job by listing the opening with an ESDS in any area where qualified candidates might be found.

claim: Providing openings to a privately run job service or exchange satisfies the contractor listing obligation.
quote: Providing information on employment openings to a privately run job service or exchange will satisfy the contractor's listing obligation

claim: If the contractor uses an external job search organization, it must give the ESDS that organization contact information.
quote: the contractor shall also provide to the employment service delivery system the contact information for the job search organization(s)

claim: Personnel and employment records must be kept for two years from the date of the record or personnel action, whichever is later.
quote: shall be preserved by the contractor for a period of two years from the date of the making of the record or the personnel action involved

claim: Contractors with fewer than 150 employees, or without a Government contract of at least $200,000, keep records for one year instead.
quote: if the contractor has fewer than 150 employees or does not have a Government contract of at least $200,000, the minimum record retention period will be one year

claim: Records required under 60-300.44(k), the veteran data collection, must be kept for three years.
quote: Records required by §§ 60-300.44(f)(4), 60-300.44(k), and 60-300.45(c) shall be maintained by all contractors for a period of three years

claim: Executive Order 11246 was revoked by Executive Order 14173 on January 21, 2025.
source_title: Modifications to the Regulations Implementing VEVRAA (Federal Register 2026-17116)
quote: Executive Order 11246 was revoked by Executive Order 14173 on January 21, 2025.

claim: Federal contractors were told to wind down compliance with the E.O. 11246 regulatory scheme by April 21, 2025.
source_title: Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) home page
quote: Federal contractors were in turn told to wind down compliance with E.O. 11246's regulatory scheme by April 21, 2025.

claim: Section 503 and VEVRAA, with their implementing regulations, remain in effect.
source_title: Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) home page
quote: Section 503 and VEVRAA, along with their implementing regulations, remain in effect

claim: The Department of Labor published a final rule revising the VEVRAA regulations on August 21, 2026.
source_title: Federal Register search results, OFCCP documents (VEVRAA)
quote: The U.S. Department of Labor published a final rule in the Federal Register on August 21, 2026, revising its implementing regulations

claim: The final rule aligns the VEVRAA regulations with Executive Order 14173 and removes cross-references to the Executive Order 11246 authority.
source_title: Modifications to the Regulations Implementing VEVRAA (Federal Register 2026-17116)
quote: These revisions will align the regulations with Executive Order 14173 and remove the VEVRAA regulations' cross-references to the Executive Order 11246 authority.

claim: The final rule takes effect September 21, 2026.
source_title: Modifications to the Regulations Implementing VEVRAA (Federal Register 2026-17116)
quote: This rule is effective September 21, 2026.

claim: The final rule updates VEVRAA jurisdictional thresholds that the FAR Council adjusted on October 1, 2025.
source_title: Modifications to the Regulations Implementing VEVRAA (Federal Register 2026-17116)
quote: which were adjusted for inflation by the Federal Acquisition Regulation Council on October 1, 2025

claim: Illinois requires contractors to enter openings in IllinoisJobLink.com and mark them as federal contractor listings.
quote: Enter all job openings directly into the state’s labor exchange, IllinoisJobLink.com and indicate on their job listings that they are a federal contractor

claim: The Illinois IDES page still states a $100,000 threshold, which differs from the later OFCCP figure.
quote: with contracts of $100,000 or more to list their employment openings
